messages:
anya: Quick design brainstorm: what if first-run checklist felt more like a tiny progress journey (step badges + XP-like progress bar) to encourage completion instead of a plain list? Thoughts on tone and a11y?
ben: I like the motivation angle but wary of gamification for enterprise customerskeep it subtle. maybe call it "Progress" not XP.
anita: accessibility: any progress meter must expose value via aria-valuenow/valuemin/valuemax and provide text equivalents. do not convey state by color alone.
kevin: product-wise, we could give small inline milestones: "First request sent" -> +1 step. but keep rewards non-monetary: checkmark + short affirmation.
lina: copy vibe: celebratory copy should be restrained: e.g., "Nice work — request sent" vs "You earned 10 XP!". localization: short strings so german/spanish won't overflow.
anya: UX placement: progress strip at top of console home, collapsible into a compact badge when space is tight. clicking opens checklist with details and sample templates.
eben: A/B test plan: variant A = plain checklist, variant B = progress strip with subtle celebratory microcopy and small confetti animation on complete (prefers reduced-motion respects user setting). measure completion rate and time-to-first-sample.
anita: animation accessibility: respect prefers-reduced-motion; also ensure confetti isn't distracting for screen readers (should be hidden from assistive tech). update live region with text-only status.
kevin: engineering constraints: confetti is CSS+SVG lightweight. feature flag rollout is straightforward. telemetry events: onboarding.progress.view, onboarding.step.complete, onboarding.progress.complete. no sensitive payloads.
lina: copy alternatives: badge label options: "Getting started", "Progress to live", "Setup progress". my pick: "Setup progress".
anya: ordering in checklist: samples first, run request second, configure billing third. show estimated time per step (e.g., "~15s").
eben: metric targets: +10-20% checklist completion in first 7 days for progress variant. also monitor any bounce increase (if gamification annoys).
anita: keyboard & screen reader flow: progress badge focusable, Enter opens panel, panel announces total steps and current status with role=status updates on each change. focus must remain in panel until closed.
kevin: QA items: ensure no layout shift when progress bar updates, persist state server-side so refresh shows correct progress, and respect user hide/dismiss.
lina: small UI copy for completion toast: "Setup complete — your workspace is ready". also add an action "Open workspace". keep toast duration short and dismissible.
anya: opt-out: provide a small "hide progress" control in the panel header and a user pref for "Don't show setup progress". enterprise admins can disable via org settings.
eben: rollout: start with 5% new accounts for 2 weeks, then 25% if positive. A/B compare against control.
anita: final a11y checklist I'll add to PR: ARIA attributes for progress, reduced-motion support, keyboard trap, SR live region updates, contrast checks for badges.
anya: awesome. i'll mock frames in Figma and share variants + measurement plan. tagging design-review next Tue. ops-bot: Figma link uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/sample/onboard-progress-journey (preview).
